scope: production exact uncompressed S8 sample upload/readback with existing combined depth preserved; pending guest renderer integration and GPU qualification

layout.packing: S8 bytes in ((y*width+x)*samples+i) order, round up to four bytes; preserve output last-word unused bytes

upload: stencil-aspect-only zero clear; eight fragment-discard bitplane draws per logical sample; native sample-mask pipeline per group/sample; dynamic one-bit stencil write mask and passOp REPLACE reference255
depth_preservation: depthTest/depthWrite disabled, depth attachment LOAD/STORE; transitions reject UNDEFINED and include both DS aspects and unchanged per-layer sample positions
readback: compute unsigned stencil-only texture2DMSArray fetch; each invocation packs one disjoint output uint, preserves partial-word padding
synchronization: explicit queue-local image and buffer stage/access states; immutable retained descriptor pools; caller fence lifetime

native_contract.scope: deterministic Vulkan API adapter, not GPU results

shaders.validation: glslangValidator and spirv-val for Vulkan1.1; production output matches embedded SPIR-V

limitations: raw image and view metadata/lifetimes remain caller prerequisites
no Z plane import/export or depth-consuming guest draws
not connected to production guest rendering by this patch
